facts.statement: Photo art002e015228, taken on 6 April 2026 during Artemis II, seen from behind the Moon: the Moon's surface in the foreground and Earth much farther away, smaller, in the background; both partially lit by the Sun, with different phases. A faint reflection in the spacecraft window is visible.

source.title: Moon's Farside in the Foreground, Earth Beyond (art002e015228)

facts.statement: Earthset captured through the Orion spacecraft window at 6:37 p.m. EDT on 6 April 2026 during the Artemis II crew's flyby of the Moon; the dark portion of Earth is in nighttime.
The Moon is 384,400 km (238,855 miles) from Earth on average; the Artemis II astronauts took about three days to get there, and light crosses that distance in 1.3 seconds.
